findings.message: The tini package has been removed from stage-packages in the app part, but the service command still executes /usr/bin/tini. This breaks runtime execution. Either restore tini to stage-packages, remove the reference from the service command, or provide explicit justification in the PR.

summary: Trigger commit advance 000000000000000000000000000000000000000c → 000000000000000000000000000000000000000d within 1.2-24.04 track. Source recipe removes tini from staged packages without updating the service command dependency, causing runtime failure.
